definition.name: Offset Setback Lines From Floor Boundary
definition.description: Repositions four model lines as a true inward offset of a floor's boundary (long and short side distances), with arcs concentric to the floor's arcs.
definition.aiDescription: Repositions four model lines as a true inward offset of a floor's boundary (long and short side distances), with arcs concentric to the floor's arcs.
examples: set the setback lines 4 m from the long sides and 8 m from the short sides of this plot
offset the plot lines from the floor boundary
